decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model extension of the core office range with strong relevance to flexible workplaces, its uncertainty still supports keeping the option open at modest carrying cost.
The chair family is close to the established offer and was given dedicated presentation, so a premium furniture firm would usually keep it while early market acceptance becomes clearer.
This is a more niche recent line, but it builds on the firm's material and living-space capabilities, so the option value of learning still outweighs immediate withdrawal.

The sofa fits the firm's core categories, but its weaker website prominence makes it the most plausible pruning candidate in a broad portfolio, even though there is not yet enough evidence to drop it now.
The high standing table aligns well with the firm's office and conference direction and can be carried through existing channels, so keeping it is a relatively low-cost option.
Although more distant from the historic offer, the rug collection was positioned as a flagship strategic move and likely provides valuable market learning at manageable carrying cost.
